text:
lee: Opening a tiny docs PR to refresh the bootcamp quickstart: add PKCE flow, minimal python snippet, and swap cookie-helper for decklink. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4720. Need snippet sanity check (py + js) and a Linux smoke test.

anita: I'll review the Python snippet. Please include explicit env var names (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN) and a short curl example for the token exchange.

oscar: Don't mention the deprecated cookie tool. Add a one-liner migration note and a link to decklink releases (and checksum). Also add SDK compatibility callout (>=0.9.0).

ci-bot: CI: docs-build succeeded for PR #4720  preview: https://deploy-preview-4720--redwood-docs.netlify.app/bootcamp-quickstart.html

qa-nina: Running Ubuntu 22.04 smoke now. Steps to run?

lee: Steps: npm ci; npm run dev; ./decklink auth --client-id $REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback; then curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback'; open http://localhost:3000 and confirm greeting card renders.

qa-nina: Smoke complete 7e5 Decklink installed, token exchange works, UI shows "Hello, bootcamp". Left one tiny wording nit in the PR about localhost redirect advice.

lee: Thanks all 680 will fix wording and merge after spellcheck.
